description: Upgrade from the auto-detecting build: a lock with a Hermes entry and its home recorded (~/hermes-a), and a user config without "targets" – Claude Code alone is detected: status names the entry an orphan, check counts it as targetsChanged; a CLI sync under HERMES_HOME=~/hermes-b (the Hermes plugin's run) removes it from the recorded home, Hermes' own files kept, writes nothing under ~/hermes-b, warns of no move and installs Claude Code's copy; check and status then find nothing.
